# cofide_connect_workload_suppression_rule (Data Source)

Provides information about a Cofide Connect workload suppression rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cofide = {
      source  = "cofide/cofide"
      version = "~> 0.9.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "cofide" {}


variable "id" {
  description = "The ID of the workload suppression rule."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-rule-id"
}


data "cofide_connect_workload_suppression_rule" "example" {
  id = var.id
}


output "workload_suppression_rule_name" {
  value = data.cofide_connect_workload_suppression_rule.example.name
}

output "workload_suppression_rule_enabled" {
  value = data.cofide_connect_workload_suppression_rule.example.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the workload suppression rule.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the rule was created, in RFC3339 format.
- `description` (String) A human-readable explanation of why the rule exists.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is currently active.
- `kubernetes_pod` (Attributes) Matches Kubernetes pod workloads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kubernetes_pod))
- `last_updated_at` (String) The time the rule was last updated, in RFC3339 format.
- `name` (String) The name of the workload suppression rule.
- `org_id` (String) The ID of the organization.

<a id="nestedatt--kubernetes_pod"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kubernetes_pod`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_ids` (List of String) Matches only pods within these clusters.
- `labels` (Map of String) Matches pods with these Kubernetes labels.
- `namespaces` (List of String) Matches pods in these Kubernetes namespaces.
- `trust_zone_ids` (List of String) Matches only pods within these trust zones.
